description: Check if a user has a specific permission

includeSource.description: Include which role(s) grant this permission

sql: WITH UserPermissions AS (SELECT DISTINCT p.permission_name, r.role_name, r.priority, ur.expiry_date FROM {{usersTable}} u JOIN {{userRolesTable}} ur ON u.user_id = ur.user_id JOIN {{rolesTable}} r ON ur.role_id = r.role_id JOIN {{rolePermissionsTable}} rp ON r.role_id = rp.role_id JOIN {{permissionsTable}} p ON rp.permission_id = p.permission_id WHERE u.user_id = {{userId}} AND u.status = 'active' AND (ur.expiry_date IS NULL OR ur.expiry_date > CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)) SELECT CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM UserPermissions WHERE permission_name = {{permission}}) THEN 'true' ELSE 'false' END AS has_permission, CASE WHEN {{includeSource}} = true THEN LISTAGG(role_name, ',') WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY priority DESC) ELSE NULL END AS granted_by_roles FROM UserPermissions WHERE permission_name = {{permission}} OR NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM UserPermissions WHERE permission_name = {{permission}})
